{{Quote|Contrary to what the Empire would have you believe, the Rebellion isn't a bunch of traitors intent on toppling the 'true' government. We're freedom fighters trying to put things right, trying to bring back the peace and cooperation that existed for millennia throughout the Republic|Belyssa Romey|<ref name="SETSB" />}}
'''Belyssa Romey''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="SETSB" /> from [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Rebel Alliance">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], and the ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates its end to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> At some point during the war,<ref name="SETSB" /> she<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> was a [[Major/Legends|major]] with the Rebel Alliance's [[132nd Forward Division]] while it was stationed in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]].<ref name="SETSB" /> 

Romey had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and light skin. She was a passionate supporter of the Rebel Alliance and firmly asserted that the Rebels were not traitors, but rather "freedom fighters." During her time with the 132nd Forward Division, Romey carried a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]] and wore a uniform<ref name="SETSB" /> typical of a [[Rebel trooper/Legends|fleet trooper]]<ref name="The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook Second Edition">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> that consisted of a blue [[shirt]], black [[Clothing/Legends|vest]], gray trousers, black [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and a [[Armor/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="SETSB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Belyssa Romey was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]].<ref name="SETSB" />
